title: Participles: describing or accompanying
subtitle: Distinguish an attributive participle from an adverbial one.
overview: An article with a participle often makes it attributive: “the one who …”. A participle without that article can add accompanying circumstance.
The same form can be translated differently because its syntactic role changes.

sections.title: Two participle jobs
rows: the one teaching the people — attributive
while teaching the people, he says … — adverbial
having heard / while hearing, they believed — context decides

items.grc: πορευόμενος εἰς τὴν πόλιν, εἶδεν αὐτόν.
items.en: While going into the city, he saw him.
